ideas.title: Own 'marketing plan', not 'business plan'
ideas.hook: Your business plan is for the bank. This one's for customers.
ideas.why: Uses the competitor gap: LivePlan, Upmetrics, PrometAI and Venturekit all sell business plans for lenders, and Upmetrics grows with comparison pages; the R&D Lab lead on business-type SEO pages fills the rest.

sources.title: R&D Lab lead: Base44 release notes

ideas.script:
POSITIONING: "A marketing plan, not a business plan."

The gap: every big tool in this space sells a BUSINESS plan (LivePlan $20/mo, Upmetrics $14/mo, PrometAI $55/mo, Venturekit). Those are built for banks and investors: funding, projections, 40 pages. Reviewers still complain the output is generic (Venturekit: "a placeholder filled with generic content") and about surprise billing. The only direct "AI marketing plan" rival found, MarketingGuide AI, has zero reviews.

1) Landing page hero (test this line):
Headline: Your business plan is for the bank. This one's for customers.
Sub: Tell it about your business. Get a step-by-step marketing plan, a budget tracker and a calendar that goes straight into your phone.
Button: Build my marketing plan

2) Pricing line under the button (counter Venturekit's billing complaints):
"[fill in: your real price and cancel terms, e.g. cancel anytime in one click]"

3) "Growth Architect vs business plan tools" page (copy Upmetrics' comparison-page play, honestly):
- Need money from a bank or investor? Use a business-plan tool.
- Need your first customers? You need to know who to reach, what to post, what to spend, and when. That's what Growth Architect gives you.
List the real differences only: step-by-step guidance, budget tracker, calendar export, PDF download, YouTube videos and studies on where to start, the 100-person market test, Pro daily competitor watch.

4) Business-type pages (R&D Lab lead): start with 5 pages, "AI marketing plan for a barber / bakery / cleaning business / nail tech / food truck". Each shows a real sample plan excerpt Growth Architect produced for that type [fill in: generate and paste real excerpts]. Base44's new SEO dashboard and llms.txt can handle meta tags and sitemap.

5) Creator angle for UGC briefs: "Business plans are for banks" works as a spoken line, see Version B's hooks to test.

brief.headline: Rivals sell business plans; own the marketing plan
brief.summary: Your competitors (LivePlan, Upmetrics, PrometAI, Venturekit) all sell business plans for banks, and their users complain the AI output is generic and the billing is sneaky. The only direct AI marketing plan rival has zero reviews and no content. Your best opening is short videos showing a plan that's clearly about one real small business, plus a 'marketing plan, not business plan' line on your site.

notes: Searching 'Growth Architect' brings up job titles and other companies, not your site, so promos use 'link in bio' instead of 'search Growth Architect'.
Ad libraries (Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn) weren't reachable this run, so no competitor ads are confirmed yet.
LaunchForge pitched the same audience (barbers, students) on Product Hunt and got 3 points: a cold launch there won't move much.

competitors.name: LivePlan
competitors.oneLiner: Business plan + forecasting software from Palo Alto Software, aimed at founders writing plans for banks, investors and SBA loans.
competitors.contentStrategy: Search-first: ranks around #4 for 'business plan' (about 550K monthly searches) and for 'business plan template', per Semrush's Sept 2026 snapshot. No short-form content worth noting turned up.
competitors.adStrategy: Meta Ad Library, TikTok Creative Center and LinkedIn Ad Library weren't reachable from this run's tools, so no live ads could be confirmed. Semrush shows its paid search traffic fell sharply (about -82%) in Sept 2026, so it's leaning on organic.
competitors.howTheyGrew: Years of SEO and free templates (bplans.com) feeding a paid product; about 53% of visits are direct and 30% Google per Semrush. G2 reviewers (4.3/5) complain it's pricey for pre-revenue planning and its forecasting is simplistic.
competitors.lessonForUs: LivePlan owns 'business plan'. Don't fight there. Own 'marketing plan for my <business type>', the question a barber or side-hustler actually asks.

competitors.name: Upmetrics
competitors.oneLiner: AI business plan generator with financial forecasting, for small businesses and startups.
competitors.contentStrategy: Publishes a page for nearly every rival ('PrometAI alternatives', '15MinutePlan alternatives', 'LivePlan vs Venturekit') and puts itself first on each one.
competitors.adStrategy: Meta Ad Library, TikTok Creative Center and LinkedIn Ad Library weren't reachable from this run's tools, so no live ads could be confirmed.
competitors.howTheyGrew: Says it has 5,000+ customers in 160 countries (eChai founder profile) and is hiring SEO talent. The visible lever is comparison/alternatives pages that catch people already shopping for a competitor. Rated 4.7/5 on G2 (29 reviews); cons are few templates and no QuickBooks/Xero links.
competitors.lessonForUs: Copy the comparison-page play cheaply: one honest 'Growth Architect vs business-plan tools' page that says when you need a marketing plan instead.

competitors.name: Venturekit
competitors.oneLiner: AI business plan, forecast and pitch-deck generator with a free tier and paid unlocks.
competitors.price: Free tier; Pro reviewers mention $19 and $96/yr charges
competitors.contentStrategy: Directory listings (Futurepedia, G2 AI, B12) rather than its own social content, as far as this run could find.
competitors.adStrategy: Meta Ad Library, TikTok Creative Center and LinkedIn Ad Library weren't reachable from this run's tools, so no live ads could be confirmed.
competitors.howTheyGrew: Free plan as the hook, then paid unlocks of locked sections. It's hurting it: Trustpilot 3.8/5 on 107 reviews with 39% one-star, mostly surprise annual billing, hard cancellation, no support replies, and plans called 'a placeholder filled with generic content'.
competitors.lessonForUs: Their reviews are a script: people hate generic plans and surprise charges. Show a plan that's obviously about one real business, and be loud about clear pricing.

competitors.name: PrometAI
competitors.oneLiner: AI business planning platform with financial projections and an 'Entrepreneur Journey' toolset.
competitors.contentStrategy: Writes its own 'evaluation of AI business plan generators' blog post to rank on comparison searches.
competitors.adStrategy: Meta Ad Library, TikTok Creative Center and LinkedIn Ad Library weren't reachable from this run's tools, so no live ads could be confirmed.
competitors.howTheyGrew: Trustpilot 4.7/5 on 43 reviews; users praise speed ('a full business plan in a couple of minutes') and that it builds with you, not for you. The one repeated ask is lower prices.
competitors.lessonForUs: 'Builds with you' is what reviewers love. Growth Architect already guides step by step, so say that in the first line of promos, not just 'AI makes a plan'.

competitors.name: MarketingGuide AI
competitors.oneLiner: AI marketing plan generator (plans, personas, email sequences) for freelancers and small businesses. The closest direct match to Growth Architect.
competitors.adStrategy: Meta Ad Library, TikTok Creative Center and LinkedIn Ad Library weren't reachable from this run's tools, so no live ads could be confirmed.
competitors.howTheyGrew: No visible traction yet: 0 reviews on Capterra and no free trial.
competitors.lessonForUs: Direct rivals in 'AI marketing plan' are tiny and quiet. The category is open; whoever shows real small-business plans on TikTok first gets it.

competitors.name: LaunchForge
competitors.oneLiner: AI 'business operating system': six agents build a go-to-market plan (29 assets) from one description, pitched at 'founders, barbers, plumbers, students'.
competitors.adStrategy: Meta Ad Library, TikTok Creative Center and LinkedIn Ad Library weren't reachable from this run's tools, so no live ads could be confirmed.
competitors.howTheyGrew: Launched on Product Hunt in 2026 (about 4 months ago) and got 3 points and no comments. A Product Hunt launch alone did nothing for this kind of tool.
competitors.lessonForUs: Same audience pitch as us (barbers, students) and it went nowhere with a cold launch. Short-form video plus creators is the better bet; don't count on a Product Hunt day.
